# New referral

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Send a new referral to one or more wards, an ED or a community team.

## What is on the screen

1. Refer to. A ward, a community team or an ED. The steps below change to suit.
2. The steps. Patient, Referral, then the checks and the places to ask. Each step says how many answers it still needs.
3. The patient. Find the patient, or choose Add patient for someone new. Not yet identified covers a person whose name is not known.
4. Catchment. Worked out from the suburb on the record. Use this catchment to accept it, or choose another.
5. Before you send. What is still needed, step by step. Choose a row to go to the step that answers it.
6. Preview letter. Shows the referral as the receiving place will read it. Back to edit returns to the form.
7. Save draft. Keeps the referral in this tab until it reloads, so you can come back to it.
8. Send. Send stays locked until every step is answered, and says what it is waiting on.

## On a phone

- The referral so far. Where the referral is going. It reads Fill in and send until it has gone.
- Continue. Takes you to the next step still needed. It sends once every step is in.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
